name: Hyrule's Mods (QoL & Cheats Collection)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Essential Offline Mode enablers, live main menu customization, P2P multiplayer, and optional solo cheats.
description: All-in-one Offline Mode Quality-of-Life, Enablers, and Trainer Cheats collection by HyruleChosenOne. Enables the Custom Characters region (2000-9999), restores past seasonal events in a dedicated Choose-Mode hub without altering your wallpaper or music, unlocks direct IP:Port P2P Co-op multiplayer, and adds live 3D main menu diorama and music selectors alongside optional solo speed/combat cheats and save utilities.
highlights: Custom Characters Enabler for non-standard character packs (#2000-#9999)
Events Enabler restoring Lavender Tower Night and Mewtwo Strikes Back in a dedicated hub
Direct IP:Port Peer-to-Peer Co-op multiplayer hosting and joining
Live 3D Main Menu Wallpaper and Music selector (supports additive custom music)
Optional solo Offline cheats (Run Speed 1x/1.5x/2x, God Mode, Overdrive, Unlock All Difficulties, and Trainer Save Utilities)
